notes.title: Fishing improved
notes.content:
Fishing is a touch deeper now.

if the fish is pulling the line the same time as the player, it gets damaged (and can snap) based on how much force is applied to the line.

But the fish has stamina it eventually exhausts giving you a window thats a little more safe to reel in.

But its slightly gambly since it recharges just a little slower then the rng dash count.

And the recharge threshold is random.

So the first quater is relatively safe.

But you cant ride the bar.

And the more you do the more likely itll catch you at a bad time and snap the line.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/715c75bb47e861235a6671e44a6b1ec4439985d0.gif[/img]

notes.content:

The terrain in the intro broke because of changes to how i handle terrain data, so i completely remodelled this area.

The vents were soft lockable since you didnt have a dex check in the freezer, so i think i fixed that.

notes.title: Next fest grind! Lots updated!
notes.content:
A lots changed since the last build, not sure if i can remember everything but ill try my best :) 

Still a lot of work left to do, but i tidied up the sisters monastery a little.

The elevator room shouldn't be accessible, but it shouldn't soft lock the game if you get in there now.

I added vents to connect the spare room to the freezer with dex check of level 5.

Ranged weapons can now affect agro.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/1dff1a0499cda210c8c566d08cd33cf4e672dd39.png[/img]

The main story hook of the moon being split in half is presented at the start now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/7000f1fc835f6b3723742967fc5bd57ce0832290.gif[/img]

The bus stop leads to the start of what im calling "Day Trips"

These will be group activities for people who want to do more focused multiplayer content.  

Just a little bit of fun, lets me make little mini games out of the mechanics i add instead of just using them for the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/0256f49e92895c02baddd71a6998ee7e941074ae.gif[/img]

The first example ive started working on im calling javelin dash

Its not much yet, but i think it could be a fun climbing game.

Im planning to add ropes you can throw down as you climb instead of checkpoints so your friends can use them too if theyre struggling.

But also if its a race it gives more incentive to try and use them more sparingly so the competition doesn't immediately catch up.

Ive also been working on replacing the terrain since it was hard to get working with the fluid tech, while trying the the vibe of the terrain.

So now there are triplanar versions of the wobbly pixel shader, which are a little messy and mixely, but i added the ability to scale the blood texture to try and mitigate that the best i can.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/2df4035de08b28b1dd5ff81286612f5f0757765c.png[/img]

I added a new room, which will eventually be the spoonies den, but at the moment its just bunk beds and a bed fort.

This will be for faction quests related to the spoonies, the plan is that you will have to gain rep with the other spoonies before you can talk to the leader who lives in the sheet fort at the back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/d3ed10c5e9e2e0b2b88a1eefb791e9e558d3266d.png[/img]

The overworld is a work in progress, im feeling really guilty about the state of it and how close we are, but we are moving, hopefully it can be a little more complete in time if i work hard for the next few days.

I also added collectables for overworld levelling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/dd99789fc9f07231d0ed8ea6f03b0c3bc5b1eb3f.png[/img]

Bull = strength level up
These collectables will be guarded by a stronger then average for the area monster.

Running man = Athletics
These will be obtained by reaching hard to get areas.

Gun = Dexterity
These will be obtained by shooting targets.

Lightbulb = Intelligence
These will be obtained by performing tile puzzles

Campfire = Survival
im not sure what im going to do for survival yet

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/2bced0347de9884417d35d890de087e0c851bd04.gif[/img]

Above is the example of the first tile based puzzle.  Just a simple line to start, hopefully teaches starts and ends on its own, but ill probably prompt the player on what the start is to make it a little less confusing.

notes.title: Big update!
notes.content:
Super tired so just gona list what I remember.  Might miss some stuff, its been a little while in the oven.
When in dev screenshot mode (f1) if you press (f2) it will take a steam screenshot, which will be embeded with your current location, and everyone in your current lobby.

You can now create a party in the main menu instead of having to go to your apartment in game.

Reworked AI so its more manageable to write stuff for it for fighting, and more generic so i can eventually apply it to everything.  And so they can fight each other instead of just the player.

I also changed to combat to affect AI (draws agro on damage) and faction related stuff to affect whos on sight.  Will probably need to keep tweaking though.

Now the zombie interaction after you steal the key to leave the starting area functions

The jeb moment in the cupboard works.

The procedural audio demo has been added and works.

And a path back to town after

A skip button on second playthrough so you dont have to re experience all of the intro stuff.

The main menu has a cool song i found on pixabay, and the logo kinda bops to it now, which was a fun distraction.

Probably more, i know i did misc fixes like bubble logic got muddled with ice logic.

But i need to sleep, its 4am.  So im going to push the build and go close my eyes.

Hope it feels a bit better.

Gona turn my focus to the town tomorrow.  Everywhere needs a lot of work, but it needs it the most atm.

If anyones interested in the procedural audio stuff, i did a twitter thread on the how i did it here.  https://twitter.com/JofersGames/status/1616174262410166284

notes.title: BIG UPDATE - Fluid persistance
notes.content:
Sorry i went dark for a bit, ive been wrestling with the fluid systems to try and give them a little more life.

Its still paint based like before but now i can do things like propagate flies around vomit patches
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/fe98fe5071f806524f716f181af636b71b4266e1.gif[/img]

And since that data is now in world space instead of uv space, i can do things like this so other npcs can smell your vomit and start hurling themselves,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/7b977f817bf9be7ba99d30ed8f4a203d499b27a2.gif[/img]

And by washing the vomit away with other fluids like the snow from the new snow gun

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/d8573a980ad854119bbd34b9b5e0ea76a89db302.gif[/img]

The flies slowly disperse.

The snow gun also triggers the new onhit freeze effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/3f895de6b34ea5a5d1087aae8cf1c09cde4e83d4.gif[/img]

But the most exciting part to me for the new systems is how oil extends the fire spread.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/95bda1f7b660ef9032c90c256ecc2033251d7340.gif[/img]

I Works with melee weapons too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/fa9fbbba9d22777451ce030b50c9edcb0bbff9b7.gif[/img]

And can be washed away in the same way the vomit is.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/d9fb70f9004731836278e0383aaae3a7e573bc72.gif[/img]

I also added a sword to test a concept of "shred" weapons that inflict "bleeding"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/a1b7088f80016740be54998149fc630b47ae6dad.gif[/img]

Im kinda wiped after this patch, but the march forward must continue.

So its onto the real next fest grind now, its a mess atm.  It needs a LOT of work before that point, and im probably not going to make it with everything i want, so im going to have to really prioritise updates to certain places for the next few weeks and its not going to be fun.

notes.title: Photo mode!
notes.content:
I shouldnt really include this in the build since im sure theres certain circumstances where it can break stuff. 

But i think its really pleasant, and i tried to put some guard rails up so hopefully its fine.

Be warned if you do want to use it though, try not to be triggering too many whacky things that might overwrite camera states when turning it on, if you dont want to soft lock.

Its F1 to toggle photo mode.

Then WASD to move around.

and Space to fly up.

And Control to fly down.

Should make snapping memorable moments with your friends a little easier.

notes.content:
Replaying the intros was a lot of time to eat, especially since the intention for the final product is for it to be replayed for other endings.

So ive broken a lot of things, and now upon replaying there will be a skip button that lets you skip everything.  Youll still be able to go through it if you like to swap item / stats for free.  But you will still be able to swap them if you skip, just probably at cost when i get the library / town hall-y thing or whatever it ends up being, done.

But at least the bones are there now.

notes.title: The demo now ends

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/b0c1bc061f99e43124a6d1899115a082151e0014.png[/img]

I want there to be a joy in experimenting and pushing the systems.  But also if you just want to have a favourite stick / gun, I want that to be an ok choice too :)
Also made some minor tweaks to the intro dream sequence.

notes.title: THE START OF MULTIPLAYER!
notes.content:
Its not much yet,  And im not 100% sure it works yet, but you should now be able to create an online group. 

And everyone in the group should have a net player sync to their position.

Tomorrow i need to test if you can invite friends (Its 4am i need sleeps im running on fumes).  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/4427628791441604eaffce020d485e0b7101f79a.gif[/img]

The intent for where this goes in the future is for it to be relatively passive, no pvp invasions, no pve affecting your world state.

But more jolly vibes, you can meet and show your friends things around the map, show off your spirit monsters.  

But the bit im most excited about adding is active instances.

I want certain (helpful) inventory items to be able to be spawned and passed through the realms.

One of the more simpler examples im fairly certain ill include is bonfires.

Drop a bonfire near your group, and you all get its regenerative properties.  

A nice rest by the warmth to break up the trip.  And it lets you share the load while dealing with finite invent space.

I want to go further then this, but i dont want to make promises i cant keep.  And im already drowning in scope, so for now the goal is just walk about and place bonfires for each other.

notes.title: Release day!
notes.content:
First day publicly visible on the store! Exciting! Scary! Stressful! A long way to go, but its gona be a fun one.  

Its gona be a while before it starts to feel whole, but im slowly chipping away.

Today i made a start on the backend of how the crystal stuff is going to work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/a82a32a3b6e711f93bce52a85422e8802ab7862e.png[/img]

The intention behind the crystal is like a soul tap thing, for a monster battling side thing, this is the start of grey boxing the front of the research centre.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/9c3721fff969d17added5f7644a42d3fe3bde4f1.png[/img]

And these are the terminals in the back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/951cd22748dd37a8c2d44c28db5250f68d5dc563.png[/img]

The panel at the back will be where you select your spirit monster and edit its abilities (spirit chips you find around the world)

The panel on the left is going to skill trees (fill an invent with chips but just taking their passive stats instead of actives)

And the panel on the right is going to be upgrades (auto chess style match 3, with 3 tiers of matches)

Theres still a long way to go before this is functional, but when it gets closer to functional i will be going into greater detail on how i intend it all to work.

If your seeing this since its the first public blog post, i want to again thank you for dropping by. 

And again im sorry its so messy and incomplete right now, but im gona be trying for daily updates like this.  So if you liked any of it, please consider popping your head back in the door in a couple of weeks, should be feeling a lot more homely by then :)
